original_target.title: Optimal stable manifold widths of Besov balls
original_target.area: Stable nonlinear approximation and numerical analysis

scope_comparison: Theorem 4.1 supplies Hilbert-space upper bounds at gamma=2; section 6.4 equation 6.15 leaves the general Besov/Sobolev upper bound, especially p!=2. Ordinary manifold widths with continuous maps, decoder-only Lipschitz/Hölder widths, and n-dependent stability constants do not satisfy the target's two fixed-gamma Lipschitz maps.
